description: This file defines the PHP class 'SurveyQuestionResponsesDashlet', which is a Dashlet used in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM interface for displaying survey question responses. It extends DashletGeneric and sets up properties like title, search fields, columns, and seedBean based on configuration files and default behaviors.

classes.name: SurveyQuestionResponsesDashlet
